blocks.text: # APEX-direct formal matrix — frozen evidence index

This directory preserves the valid three-repeat, 18-cell APEX-derived SPA
Artifact Handoff matrix. It is not an official APEX score. Each report was
written by an isolated receiver run; `analysis-v2.json` is the deterministic
cross-run analysis.

The primary endpoint is admission correctness before continuation: clean
requires `proceed`; the stale-binding fault requires `reverify` or `stop`.
Native nine-criterion quality is reported only for clean cells with a correct
proceed and a completed native artifact. A clean false rejection and an agent
step-limit/unfinalized run remain in the all-clean-cell completion denominator;
they are not silently converted into a zero native score.
